Gold and Silver Prices Fall for Fifth Consecutive Day

Gold prices have decreased for the fifth consecutive day, with silver also seeing a significant drop of ₹5,000 per kilogram. Following Diwali, gold prices fell by 5.7% and silver by 8.8%. On MCX, silver experienced a sudden crash of ₹6,000 per kilogram, while gold became ₹3,000 cheaper. This marks the second consecutive day of declining prices for both precious metals, offering relief to buyers.
